name: Class trainers do not offer the stock Dual Talent Specialization
contract: Ascension has no stock Dual Talent Specialization; specializations come from spec books and the specialization swap
spells. A class trainer's menu offers training and unlearning talents only: no "I wish to know about Dual Talent
Specialization." and no 1000 gold purchase, at a level where stock AzerothCore would show them (40+, one spec).
